settings.engine.label: Recognition executable
settings.engine.description: The installed recognition engine to run. It is used as it is: the plugin never rebuilds or replaces it.
settings.model.label: Model GGUF
settings.model.description: The GGUF model the engine loads for every recognition job.
settings.recording.label: Recording to transcribe
settings.recording.description: A saved 16 kHz mono signed-16-bit WAV. It is validated before inference and never modified.
settings.threads.label: Inference threads
settings.threads.description: Thread count passed to the engine. The OpenMP and OpenBLAS limits follow it.
settings.delivery.label: Delivery
settings.delivery.description: Automatic copies the finished transcript and sends the ordinary paste shortcut into the window the recording was started from. It needs wtype installed, and the transcript goes on the clipboard first, where a clipboard manager keeps it in its history. Manual never pastes, so it needs no paste tool: the transcript is only copied when you ask for it.
settings.delivery.auto: Automatic (paste into the window you recorded from)
